title: Detailed castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free castle, centered -->
  <!-- main keep -->
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='24' height='45' fill='#b8a8d8'/>
  <!-- keep roof -->
  <polygon points='38,40 62,40 50,24' fill='#e05a7a'/>
  <!-- keep roof shading -->
  <polygon points='50,24 62,40 50,40' fill='#c04460'/>
  <!-- keep windows -->
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='5' height='7' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <rect x='51' y='46' width='5' height='7' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='60' width='5' height='7' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <rect x='51' y='60' width='5' height='7' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <!-- keep door -->
  <rect x='46' y='73' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#7a4a30'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='79' r='1' fill='#ffe07a'/>

  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='16' y='46' width='16' height='39' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <!-- left tower roof -->
  <polygon points='14,46 34,46 24,28' fill='#e05a7a'/>
  <polygon points='24,28 34,46 24,46' fill='#c04460'/>
  <!-- left tower crenellations -->
  <rect x='14' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='20' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='26' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='30' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <!-- left tower window -->
  <rect x='21' y='54' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <rect x='21' y='68' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffe07a'/>

  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='68' y='46' width='16' height='39' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <!-- right tower roof -->
  <polygon points='66,46 86,46 76,28' fill='#e05a7a'/>
  <polygon points='76,28 86,46 76,46' fill='#c04460'/>
  <rect x='66' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='72' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='78' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='82' y='44' width='4' height='5' fill='#a090c8'/>
  <rect x='73' y='54' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffe07a'/>
  <rect x='73' y='68' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffe07a'/>

  <!-- flags -->
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='50' y2='15' stroke='#ffe07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='50,15 60,18 50,21' fill='#7ad0ff'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='28' x2='24' y2='20' stroke='#ffe07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='24,20 32,22 24,24' fill='#7ad0ff'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='28' x2='76' y2='20' stroke='#ffe07a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='76,20 84,22 76,24' fill='#7ad0ff'/>

  <!-- wall connecting pieces -->
  <rect x='32' y='62' width='6' height='23' fill='#b8a8d8'/>
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='6' height='23' fill='#b8a8d8'/>
  <!-- gate under wall -->
  <rect x='32' y='78' width='36' height='7' fill='#8a78b0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='78' width='16' height='7' fill='#7a4a30'/>

  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='10' y='85' width='80' height='8' rx='4' fill='#6ac07a'/>
  <!-- little bushes -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='83' r='5' fill='#4ea85e'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='83' r='5' fill='#4ea85e'/>
</svg>
